description: Increases front door sill height to 1.3 meters for new homes.
Raises allowable sidewall area by 10% for new builds.
Exempts some sidewall areas further from property lines.
Reinstates second-story size limit for garage suites.

chips.text: Councillor Derek called the sidewall area rule "overly restrictive
Regulations apply to primary dwellings in established pre-war and post-war neighbourhoods.
Home Builders Association supported changes but felt they may not go far enough for smaller lots.
Councillor Derek expressed sadness that the sidewall area rule was not recommended for removal.

segments.title: Staff Report on Zoning Bylaw Amendments
segments.takeaway: Administration presented proposed amendments to the Zoning Bylaw concerning primary dwellings in established neighborhoods, focusing on front door sill height and sidewall area.

segments.title: Committee Questions and Discussion
segments.takeaway: Committee members questioned administration on the rationale for the proposed changes, their impact on various lot sizes, and the overall effectiveness of the sidewall area rule.

segments.title: Motion to Recommend Amendments
segments.takeaway: The committee moved to recommend the proposed zoning bylaw text amendments for primary dwellings to city council for a public hearing.

description: 1401 11th Street West rezoning was not approved.
